message: パッキー太助
Only a few minutes remained until Inamiya's time sale.
I should start warming up soon so I can hold my own against the fierce onslaught of the shopping aunties.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gramps, over here, hurry, hurry」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady, if I may be so bold, high-quality ingredients can be purchased via mail order」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte? Seeing you out during shopping hours is rare, isn't it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello there, Mr. Chairman」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Following the example of Gramps's delicious meals, I came to study cooking too」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's a great thing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Did you hear that, Gramps? Even Mr. Chairman says so」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady, I am not particularly skilled at teaching things to others」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Euu~, you keep saying things like that... Please impart at least how to pick out ingredients」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Lord Synn, would you be willing to accompany us as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, I don't mind?」
It's extremely rare for Riesling-san to ask a favor of me.
I think guiding Lolotte's shopping should be a piece of cake, though... Is he really that bad at explaining things?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~, Mr. Chairman is a shopping district professional, wasn't he」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yaaay\s07 Then let's have him come along with us to the fishmonger」
Skipping along, Lolotte pulls Riesling-san and me by the hands.
The shop we arrived at is the fishmonger in Shiokumi Shopping District, '\{Gyoraitei|ぎょらいてい}'.
When we held a get-together in my room, Lolotte brought tuna. She must have a strong attachment to fish dishes.

name: Riesling
message: 「Lord Synn, I leave the rest to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Fish, huh... I only know how to pick out tuna scrapings, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!?」
Riesling-san glares at me with a piercing gaze filled with intense pressure.

name: Synn
message: 「I-If you're simmering squid, tossing in some daikon radish too makes it delicious」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Tchh」

name: Synn
message: 「I-If you're going to simmer eggplant, tossing in some shrimp shells makes the color and sheen much better, and it tastes great!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, shouldn't we do the shopping first?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, yes♪ Let's train our eyes to spot good ingredients. Jeeves, please pick out a lively fish for us!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My deepest apologies, Milady, they are all quite dead.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa...」
An indescribable atmosphere hangs between us and the shopkeeper.

name: Riesling
message: 「I shall leave the follow-up for Milady and myself, Riesling Tohyama, in the capable hands of our Student Council President, Lord Synn Sakura.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-W-W-Wait just a second! How am I supposed to cover for you after you've already blown yourselves to smithereens?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「You flatter me.」

name: Synn
message: 「That wasn't a compliment!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, what are you guys even doing?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen up, okay? The way you pick out a fresh fish is--」
Showing off knowledge worthy of a fish market veteran, Paqy teaches Lolotte how to pick out fresh fish.
It kind of looks like he just wants to spout off trivia, but either way, it's a huge help.
...If Paqy hadn't been here, what would've become of me?
